items.q: Can foreigners buy property in Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Foreign nationals can buy freehold property in designated areas such as Downtown, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Hills Estate.

items.q: How much deposit do I need for a mortgage?
items.a: Non-residents typically need 40–50% and residents 20–25% for properties under AED 5M. Our finance team will confirm your exact eligibility.
Budget around 7–8% of the price: 4% DLD fee, agency fee, registration and mortgage-related fees where applicable.

items.q: How does the Golden Visa work?
items.a: Investing AED 2M or more in property can qualify you for a renewable 10-year UAE residency visa. We manage the whole process.
